findings.summary: The fixed mobile sidebar has no vertical scrolling, so its navigation links can extend outside short viewports and receive focus while off-screen.
findings.fix: Make the mobile sidebar vertically scrollable within the viewport, for example with `max-height: 100dvh; overflow-y: auto`, and verify focused links remain visible on short screens.
findings.evidence: At max-width 860px the sidebar is displayed with 72px top padding, but no max-height or overflow-y is set.
findings.component: Shared teacher and student dashboard navigation

passed: Dashboard and login pages place a skip link first in the tab order and target a main element with tabindex="-1".
The responsive navigation uses a native button and links; its script updates aria-expanded, supports Escape, and returns focus to the toggle.
No positive tabindex values were found; keyboard focus styles are defined for links, buttons, and programmatically focused dashboard sections.
The role dashboard performs a server redirect to the role-specific page rather than an in-page route change.
notes: Automated keyboard and viewport scans could not run because Playwright is not installed; findings are based on source review.
